title: NotifyCatalogue
description: Result of notify.catalogue: the backend-owned vocabulary for notification kinds. The renderer uses these words for every kind badge, filter option and tooltip rather than duplicating the catalogue in TypeScript.

kinds.description: Every declared notification kind, including one whose trust bound leaves it with no offered delivery pair, in catalogue order.

kind.description: The wire value stamped on a notification occurrence.

label.description: The noun phrase shown wherever the notification kind is named.

description.description: The sentence explaining what produces this notification kind.
